title: IN WHICH PHILEAS FOGG DOES NOT HAVE TO REPEAT HIS ORDERS TO PASSEPARTOUT TWICE
summary_hover: Believing himself ruined, Phileas Fogg returns home, where a devastated Aouda unexpectedly proposes marriage to him, which he joyfully accepts.
summary_detail: Phileas Fogg returns to his house on Saville Row, believing he has lost his wager and his fortune. He locks himself away to settle his affairs, while a guilt-ridden Passepartout keeps watch. During an evening conversation, Fogg apologizes to Aouda for his ruin; in response, she proposes marriage to him, and he happily accepts, sending Passepartout for a clergyman.
